verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers an official CLI (verified working via probe) for running tests/collections and an official MCP server that gives an AI agent read/write access to collections, requests, environments, and teams — real programmatic control beyond just the UI. However, there is no public REST/OpenAPI API (probe found only 404s), and no evidence these interfaces cover every UI capability (e.g., admin dashboard config, SSO/OIDC enterprise features), so parity is partial rather than complete.
